text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh. ...U-Um? If this needle is pointing 
to the right, that means...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
T-This is bad... I have to do something 
before someone notices!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... Trainer! Would it be 
alright if I stayed a bit longer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi has frequently stayed 
behind for voluntary training these past 
few days. While her dedication is 
admirable...
choice_data_list:
You've been staying late a lot lately, is 
everything okay?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? ...No no! It's nothing! Just felt 
like moving my body a bit more!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Judging from her behavior, it seems 
there's something she doesn't want known."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—100 laps around the perimeter!! I am 
gonna lose weight, just you watch me~!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —It's okay, I'm okay. I know I can...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later. While training with her 
once again...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hmm hum hum! Pretty light on my feet, huh? 
I've been feeling in top shape lately!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Tsuyoshi is gonna go run one more lap!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed to have resolved whatever was 
troubling her, moving with a light step. I 
didn't know what the reason was, but it 
seemed to be a positive change for her as 
an athlete.
